svg.title: 54 hash chains · 18 steps each
svg.desc: 54 chains of 18 steps feed 18 ternary group hashes and then the public key. The low 127 digest bits select a whole disclosure pattern through a fixed enumeration, accepting indices below 45 × 2¹⁰⁸. Signing retries the nonce otherwise. Each cut reveals six group values and 36 chain values with 82 chain hashes remaining. The drawing illustrates an allowed cut, without claiming a particular digest index. Blue dots are revealed values, blue paths are recomputed, and grey branches are unused for this cut.
svg.text: One index selects a whole pattern
Accept i < 45 × 2¹⁰⁸; otherwise try a new nonce.
